Quantized (10 – 17, 0.52 – 0.57) and fine-tuned (5.5 – 8, 0.56 – 0.65) both diverge later and have lower edit distance. Exact match of 0.016 is slightly above the system-prompted 0.000, and stage directions did not rise, so there is some uncertainty.
